_comment: Paste the 'hcp' entry below into your Claude Code MCP config (typically ~/.claude/mcp.json on mac/Linux, %USERPROFILE%\.claude\mcp.json on Windows). Substitute {{WORKER_URL}} with your full https://<subdomain>.workers.dev URL and {{TOKEN}} with the token you minted in INSTALL.md Phase 6. If the file already has an 'mcpServers' object, just add the 'hcp' entry inside it — don't replace the whole file.
